title: Enderman Spawn with End Blocks
description: makes endermen have a 1/20 (5%) chance to spawn with either end stone or a chorus flower.
body:
this pack makes endermen have a chance to spawn with end stone or chorus flowers in their hands. this is for weirdos who prefer to not go to the end. (me, I'm weirdos)

it also adds a recipe a la the granite, diorite, and andesite recipes to make more end stone, in case you want to use it as a building block.

# ! Heads Up !
on first install, this'll apply to ALL endermen in your world, not just newly spawned ones. so if you have endermen in boats or minecarts holding blocks, there's a small chance that their block will be replaced. I don't really know how to avoid this.

also, as a consequence of endermen with blocks being unable to despawn, this pack will inherently mean that your world will very slowly, but surely, become littered with end stone, and your main end island will be littered with chorus trees. also don't know how to avoid this. maybe don't install this pack if you have access to the end.
